title: Pure Felgrand
match: Ruins of the Divine Dragon Lords
summary: Felgrand is a Level 7/8 LIGHT Dragon graveyard revival archetype centered around Divine Dragon Lord Felgrand, Arkbrave Dragon, and Return of the Dragon Lords. Whenever Divine Dragon Lord Felgrand is Special Summoned from the GY, it banishes a monster from the opponent's field or GY and gains ATK, while Arkbrave Dragon wipes face-up Spells/Traps and revives Felgrand during the next Standby Phase.

allow.Dragon Shrine: Sends a Dragon from the Deck to the GY (like Arkbrave Dragon or Divine Dragon Lord Felgrand) to set up Standby Phase revivals and Return of the Dragon Lords.
allow.Trade-In: Discards a Level 8 Felgrand monster to draw 2 cards while putting Felgrand directly into the GY to be revived.
allow.Foolish Burial: Sends Arkbrave Dragon or Divine Dragon Lord Felgrand directly from the Deck to the GY (1 copy, Limited in TCG).
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Dragon Xyz made with two Level 8 Felgrand Dragons that negates Spells and redirects attacks.
allow.Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres: Link-2 Dragon made with any two Dragons that bounces an opposing card and summons Arkbrave Dragon or Felgrand from the Deck.

main: Divine Dragon Lord Felgrand

Signature Level 8 Dragon boss: when Special Summoned from the GY, targets 1 monster your opponent controls or in their GY, banishes it, and gains ATK/DEF equal to its Level/Rank x 100; revives a Level 7/8 Dragon from GY when it destroys a monster by battle.
Arkbrave Dragon

Level 7 Dragon companion: banishes as many face-up Spells/Traps your opponent controls as possible when Special Summoned from the GY, and revives a Level 7 or 8 Dragon (Felgrand!) during the Standby Phase of the next turn after being sent to the GY.
Paladin of Felgrand

Level 4 Warrior that equips a Level 7 or 8 Dragon from your hand or Deck on Normal/Special Summon, is unaffected by other monsters' effects while equipped, and tributes itself + 1 monster to revive a Level 7/8 Dragon from the GY.
Guardian of Felgrand
Level 4 Warrior that equips a Level 7/8 Dragon from hand or GY on Summon, gains half its ATK/DEF, and tributes itself + 1 monster to revive a Level 7/8 Dragon.
Dragon Knight of Creation

Level 4 Dragon that increases its Level by 4 during the opponent's turn, sends a Level 7/8 Dragon from Deck to GY when destroying a monster by battle, and sends 1 card from hand + itself to revive a Level 7/8 Dragon from the GY.
Felgrand Dragon
Original Level 8 Felgrand Dragon that gains ATK equal to a GY monster's Level x 200 when revived from the GY.
Return of the Dragon Lords
Core Spell that Special Summons any Level 7 or 8 Dragon monster from your GY, and banishes itself from your GY to protect your Dragon monster(s) from being destroyed by battle or card effect.
Ruins of the Divine Dragon Lords

Continuous Spell that negates the effects of any monster Special Summoned from anywhere EXCEPT the GY while you control a Level 7/8 Dragon, and sends 1 other face-up card you control (an equipped Arkbrave Dragon!) to the GY to summon a Dragon Lord Token.
Dragon Shrine
Sends Arkbrave Dragon or Divine Dragon Lord Felgrand directly from the Deck to the GY.
Trade-In
Discards Divine Dragon Lord Felgrand or Felgrand Dragon to draw 2 cards and put them into the GY for revival.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Arkbrave Dragon to the GY so it revives Felgrand during the Standby Phase.
extra: Signature Rank 8 Xyz boss that detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to target any face-up monster on the field, negating its effects AND making it completely unaffected by other card effects this turn.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Rank 8 Dragon Xyz made with two revived Level 8 Dragons to negate Spells.
Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres
Link-2 Dragon that bounces a card and summons Arkbrave Dragon from the Deck (sending it to GY in the End Phase to trigger its revival!).
